transcript:
Header:
Date: Sep 16, 2025 14:00 PT
Duration: ~58m
Attendees: Alex Chen (Redwood), Priya Nair (Redwood), Diego Ramos (Redwood), Nia Wallace (Redwood), Maya Singh (LaunchPad), Ben Turner (LaunchPad), Ivy Park (LaunchPad), Ravi Patel (LaunchPad)
Notes: co-marketing webinar with partner LaunchPad Labs; heavy focus on registration funnel, paid amplification, tracking, and demo environment for live demo. Shared deck link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/launchpad-webinar (placeholder).

Auto-summary (auto-gen, may be rough):
- Agree on target audience segments: startup infra, platform teams, fintech devs.
- Registrant goal 2.5k, live attendees 600-800, MQLs 250+ (10% conv from live).
- Co-branded landing page + UTMs; Redwood to own GA tagging; LaunchPad to run partner promo.
- Rehearsal 2025-10-07 10am PT, final dry run 2025-10-12.
- Paid channels: LinkedIn, X ads, community newsletters, partner emails; test creative A/B.

Transcript body:
[00:00] Alex: hey everyone, thanks for jumping on, um we're on the record, recording on. quick round robin, real quick — say your name and role.
[00:06] Maya: maya here, partnerships at launchpad labs. excited to co-host.
[00:09] Ben: ben, head of gtm, i'll focus on distribution and metrics.
[00:12] Alex: alex, redwood marketing, i'll coordinate creative and landing page.
[00:15] Priya: priya, growth product, i'll own funnels and paid.
[00:18] Diego: diego, content, i'll do asset creation and repurposing.
[00:20] Ivy: ivy, events, logistics.
[00:22] Nia: nia, partnerships on redwood side, i'll handle partner comms.
[00:25] Ravi: ravi, demand gen for launchpad.

[00:28] Alex: ok, first item — audience and goal. we recommend focusing on platform/infra teams evaluating inference for production. target registrants 2,500 — that's our stretch number; comfortable number 1k. live attendees target around 600 to 800. are those reasonable?
[00:40] Ben: yeah 2.5k is stretch, but with both of our audiences and partner lists it's possible. we can commit our nurture list of 18k but open to segmentation.
[00:47] Maya: we have a strong community in fintech dev slack channels too, could push there. question: what's our mql definition? we need aligned criteria.
[00:55] Priya: good point — proposed MQL is request for trial or demo interest within 30 days post-event OR attended live and completed demo form — roughly conversion target 10% of live.
[01:05] Ben: that fits. let's capture explicit interest flags on the registration form: checkbox for privacy, and a dropdown 'I'm evaluating' vs 'just curious'.

[01:18] Alex: landing page — co-branded. idea: single URL with utm_source=launchpad, utm_medium=partner, utm_campaign=lp-webinar-sep2025. redwood will host the registration page and pass webhooks to both CRMs. any security concerns?
[01:30] Maya: we need to confirm data sharing rules; we can't pass email to third parties without consent. must show opt-in language.
[01:35] Nia: redwood side — we'll make sure the form includes explicit consent and a toggle for sharing leads with partner. Dean? (laughs)
[01:40] Priya: also need to add hidden fields for GCLID and campaign id, and we'll do server-side tagging for reliability.

[01:50] Diego: creative — hero image, speaker headshots, 45s highlight reel of the demo. question: can we get a staging demo video from your SE that doesn't expose customer data?
[01:58] Ivy: yes we'll get a scrubbed demo recording.
[02:01] Ben: for the live demo we need a fallback plan — what if the live environment hits rate limits? Priya mentioned a recorded demo fallback.
[02:07] Priya: yes plan A live in Redwood Dedicated dev cluster, but if that misbehaves we'll auto-play the recorded demo clip and continue. set expectations in run-of-show.
[02:15] Alex: small note — 'Redwood Dedicated' sometimes shows up in legal as 'Redwood Dedicate' in our contracts, so double check the naming in the deck. (laughs) transcription artifact: redwood ded....

[02:25] Maya: promotion cadence — partner email 1 to their list, 2 weeks out; social posts x3; ad buys start 14 days out with retargeting until day-of; paid budget estimate request?
[02:33] Priya: initial recommendation $8k total paid across both co-markets: $4k LinkedIn (lead gen), $2k X/Threads boosts, $1k Reddit/community ads, $1k retargeting on Meta. split and test creatives A/B.
[02:45] Ravi: that aligns. we'll allocate more to LinkedIn for platform roles, but test smaller audiences on X and niche communities.

[02:55] Alex: what's the org for rehearsals? propose two rehearsals: speaker run 10/07 and dress rehearsal 10/12. Ivy, can events manage scheduling?
[03:02] Ivy: yes 10/07 10am PT for speaker run, 10/12 9am PT for dress; will calendar invite. ensure all speakers have slides and talking points a week before.

[03:12] Diego: content repurposing plan: record the webinar, chop into 3x 45s clips, 2x 2min explainer, blog post + transcript for SEO. Redwood will provide 5 pull quotes.
[03:22] Alex: also want to capture evaluation prompts — post-webinar survey link to capture product fit signals. Priya, can you build the survey and tags?
[03:30] Priya: yep i'll use Typeform, and pipe responses to segment; we'll flag 'schedule a demo' and 'need pricing' answers as high intent.

[03:38] Ben: reporting — shared dashboard with registrants, live attendees, attendee dropoff, minutes watched, survey responses. CRM sync every 6 hours. who owns dashboard?
[03:45] Nia: redwood will host a Looker/Sheets with auto-updates. Alex to share access.
[03:48] Maya: LaunchPad wants a scoreboard widget of partner referrals so we can see lifts.

[03:55] Alex: tracking — UTMs: utm_source={launchpad|redwood|partnerXYZ}, utm_medium={email|social|paid}, utm_campaign=lp-webinar-sep2025, utm_content={creativeA|creativeB}. canonicalize via server-side tags. also add 'partner' in hidden field.
[04:12] Priya: agree. also ensure we pass referral parameter to SFDC/HubSpot so attribution stays intact.

[04:20] Maya: creative examples — ask each speaker for one 140-character hook and 30-45s talking points.
[04:26] Diego: i'll draft 3 subject lines and 4 post copy variants to test.

[04:34] Alex: paid creative test plan: test creative A (problem-solution) vs B (demo-first) on LinkedIn lead gen — measure CTR, CPL, and MQL rate. target CPL <= $45, target CPL for demo signups <= $90.
[04:46] Ben: are these CPL targets aggressive?
[04:48] Priya: they're tight but doable with targeted audiences; if CPA spikes we'll scale back bids and shift to retargeting.

[04:55] Alex: ops and legal — need a mini SOC/contract clause check for co-marketing data sharing. Nia, can you loop in legal?
[05:02] Nia: yes will ping legal and privacy; we should prepare a partner addendum for data usage.

[05:07] Maya: timeline check — registration opens 2025-09-22. is that ok?
[05:10] Alex: yes open 9/22 gives 20 days lead time. evergreen emails: announcement, reminder 7 days, 2 days, 1 day, day-of, post-webinar follow-up.
[05:20] Ravi: add a 'last chance' push 3 hours before show time, we've seen lift in conversions.

[05:25] Diego: accessibility — captions and recording with transcript. can we ensure auto-captioning and human edit?
[05:29] Ivy: platform supports auto captions; Diego we'll send transcript for cleanup.

[05:35] Priya: risk register quick — low registration, demo failure, misaligned messaging, legal opt-out delays. mitigation: paid amplification, recorded fallback demo, final messaging review by Oct 1, early legal review.

[05:45] Ben: partner promo commitments? what do we expect launchpad to guarantee?
[05:48] Maya: we can commit to one email to 18k list plus two social posts. we can also provide a featured blog spot but need co-marketing approval.
[05:55] Alex: redwood will commit to two emails and paid investment on LinkedIn and retargeting. ok sounds good.

[06:00] Alex: recap quick — action items and owners, rehearsal dates, registration open 9/22, target registrants 2.5k (stretch). next call cadence — weekly until 10/05 then every other day in final week. any final q's?
[06:12] Maya: none, thanks all.
[06:15] Alex: thanks everyone. end.
